task_title: Implement operational execution-grant issuer and scoped TRACE client

reviewer_rejection_addressed.reviewer_log: Independent review rejection on frozen head 92a4a4cce36232a0ff1ffb033d8b293666f9a683
items_fixed: 1. (P1) Exclusive Private Operational MFA Outputs & Browser Download Guidance: In docs/operations/execution-grant-issuer.md § 9, replaced static /tmp paths, curl -o, and Python open(w) with a freshly created private 0700 temporary directory ($MFA_DIR via mktemp -d with chmod 0700) and an automated cleanup trap (shred -u and rm -rf on EXIT INT TERM). Intermediate and final credentials (signin-step1.json, signin-step2.json, operator-token.txt) are exclusively created and verified via Python with os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW at mode 0600 with bounded failure handling, preventing path reuse, symlink following, and 0644 permission retention. Added write_private_exclusive_file() in secure_io.py and comprehensive tests in test_issuer.py (TestSecureIoAndOperationalPatterns) validating synthetic MFA flow, symlink rejection, and reused-path rejection. In web/index.html, replaced the misleading 'Download Private Grant JSON File' label with 'Download Grant JSON (Browser Download)', added an explicit security notice regarding default browser download permissions (0644), and updated CLI instructions to route bearer saving directly through request_execution_grant.py request --grant-out <path> or require a pre-configured private directory.

2. (P2) Scoped Public-Only Key Inspection Command: Implemented inspect_key() and --inspect-key <path> in deploy/execution-grant-issuer/run_server.py, strictly reading the private key via read_private_file_strict() (enforcing regular file, mode 0600, owner-only, non-symlink) and outputting only public trust metadata (Key ID, base64url public key, SHA-256 fingerprint, and orchestrator config snippet) without disclosing private key material. Added 6 unit and CLI regression tests in test_run_server.py. Updated docs/operations/execution-grant-issuer.md § 6.3 and deploy/execution-grant-issuer/README.md § 2.5 to document both the --inspect-key direct command and the systemd startup-log fingerprint procedure.

3. (P2) Safe Shell Quoting and Failure Propagation in Documentation: Fixed docs/operations/execution-grant-issuer.md § 9 runnable snippets (Step 1, Step 2, and Step 3) to eliminate embedded single quotes inside python3 -c shell single-quoted commands, avoiding premature shell string termination and SyntaxError. Converted Step 2 into a clean symmetric pipeline without heredoc fragmentation. Added explicit pipeline status capture ($status=$?), ensuring that sensitive environment variables (OPERATOR_PASSWORD, TOTP_CODE) and intermediate files are always cleaned up while failures explicitly propagate with nonzero exit code instead of being masked by unset/shred. Added an offline regression test (TestSecureIoAndOperationalPatterns.test_documented_shell_flow_offline_regression_success_and_failure_modes) that extracts the exact dedented markdown snippets from docs/operations/execution-grant-issuer.md and executes them via bash with a synthetic curl stub under successful responses, API errors, missing claims, and file collision conditions, validating private 0600 outputs, secret unsetting, credential shredding, and nonzero failure status.

criterion_1.statement: Read and implement complete immutable SA/SD. Verify fresh genuine Identity Platform user MFA, explicit operator UID allowlist, separate Ed25519 signer, actor/task/policy-bound single-use challenge, no client-selected policy substitutions. No fixture or ADC treated as real MFA.
criterion_1.evidence: IdentityPlatformTokenVerifier unconditionally enforces check_revoked=True and rejects FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST / cached emulated clients. TestRealFirebaseSdkCryptographicVerification exercises genuine firebase_admin signature, kid, audience, issuer, disabled account, and revocation checks with AnonymousCredentials() in test fixtures, passing with absent ambient ADC. Regressions prove alg=none and emulated clients cannot obtain challenges or sign grants.

criterion_2.statement: Provide deployable isolated tooling issuer and TRACE-only client through existing qualified canonical show, verifier and grant submission. No new TaskStore writer or product route. Reject S5 and changed canonical bindings. Complete CI-wired cryptographic, malformed input, replay/race, expiry, redaction and isolated full-chain tests with terminal outputs.
criterion_2.evidence: branch-ci.yml gates execution-grant-issuer changes directly. scripts/request_execution_grant.py provides request and submit subcommands supporting private 0600 files and stdin without secret argv exposure. Full-chain tests in test_request_execution_grant.py verify authoritative TaskStore journal interaction, CAS generation checks, replay rejection, and local signature validation against .orchestrator/config.json. 71 tests in test_issuer.py + test_run_server.py and 17 tests in test_request_execution_grant.py pass (88 total issuer/client tests).

criterion_3.statement: Publish exact source/checksum/test evidence and independent exact-head review, required CI, PR merge and done/archive. Document separate-identity secret/trust deployment and actual human reauthentication requirements. This source task does not mint live credentials, assert MFA or deploy hosted product workloads.
criterion_3.evidence: docs/operations/execution-grant-issuer.md and deploy/execution-grant-issuer/README.md document immutable PANTHEON_COMMAND_ROOT promotion for key publication/rotation/rollback via promote_supervisor_runtime.py, dual key fingerprint verification via --inspect-key and service startup logs, fresh private 0700 temporary directory ($MFA_DIR) with automated cleanup trap, exclusive mode-0600 file creation via Python os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW with safe shell quoting and explicit failure propagation, and private file/stdin grant submission. All 20 source artifact checksums updated. Terminal test evidence verified for 115 passing tests (10 subtests). No live credentials, hosted deployment, or grant issuance performed.
